newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler says gp truck orders up 70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Daimler says gp truck orders up 70 pct.

text.p: German industrial giant Daimler-Benz AG said on Thursday that group truck orders were up over 70 percent in the first five months of this year.
Daimler, Germany's leading truck maker, also said it expected worldwide unit truck sales for the year as a whole to climb to around 400,000 units, what would be a 15 percent increase.
The company attributed the strong demand to its new Actros heavy truck, and commercial vans.
"The product offensive at Daimler is bearing fruit," said Kurt Lauk, commercial vehicle chief.

"Especially welcome is the high level of market acceptance since the end of last year for the Actros, with which we are building up our leading position in heavy trucks despite sharp price and condition competition."
